technique_name: Write a short story about a day in the life of a software engineer.
description: John was a software engineer and had been coding for the past 5 years. Every day he woke up early to tackle the day ahead. He would start off with a quick breakfast before diving into the world of coding, creating new projects and fixing existing bugs. After a few hours of coding, he would take a break and eat lunch at his desk, discussing new ideas with his colleagues and brainstorming solutions to any tricky problems they had encountered.
